points.description: States that the best-case number of operations for insertion sort is N (linear, O(N)), where N is the length of the array. Equivalent wording such as 'n comparisons' or 'linear time' is accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the answer gives a linear-type count but is imprecise (e.g. N-1 comparisons is fine for full marks; vague 'fast' or 'few operations' earns half).

points.description: States that the best-case scenario is when the array is already sorted (in the desired order).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if the answer says the data is 'nearly sorted' or 'mostly in order' without saying already sorted.
